title: Restriction identifies the Galois group of a normal fixed field
statement:
Let $E/F$ be a finite Galois extension of fields [def-pc-field-extension], [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]: it is finite-dimensional, separable, and the minimal polynomial over $F$ of every element of $E$ splits over $E$. Put $\Gamma=\operatorname{Aut}_F(E)$ and let $K\triangleleft\Gamma$ be a normal subgroup. Define $E^K=\{a\in E:\sigma(a)=a\text{ for every }\sigma\in K\}$. Then $E^K/F$ is Galois, and restriction induces a group isomorphism
$$\Gamma/K\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Aut}_F(E^K),\qquad [\sigma]\longmapsto\sigma|_{E^K}.$$
In particular the isomorphism acts by the indicated restrictions, rather than only identifying the abstract groups.
